skill.basicrpgclasses.whirlwind.descript: The Warrior completes a full weapon spin, hitting every enemy, including players, around them.
skill.basicrpgclasses.fortify.descriptio: Grants the Paladin and nearby allies resistance and temporary damage absorption.
skill.basicrpgclasses.fortify.stats: Duration: %s s · Resistance %s · absorption: %s hearts · radius: %s
skill.basicrpgclasses.provoke.descriptio: Mobs target the Paladin. Enemy players are revealed and briefly deal less damage to everyone except the Paladin.
skill.basicrpgclasses.ground_stun.descri: Shakes the ground around the Warrior and in a wide forward cone, stunning and weakening enemies.
skill.basicrpgclasses.ground_stun.stats: Damage: %s · close radius: %s · cone range: %s · stun: %s s
skill.basicrpgclasses.shield_bash.descri: Requires a shield. Precise aim lunges toward the target, briefly stuns it and locks mobility skills.
skill.basicrpgclasses.battle_cry.descrip: A battle roar temporarily increases the Warrior's damage and attack speed.
skill.basicrpgclasses.fireball.descripti: Sequentially launches 1–3 very fast fireballs with a short gap for the resource cost of one cast.
skill.basicrpgclasses.fireball.stats: Damage each: %s · target burning: %s s · impact flash radius: %s · fireballs per cast: %s · size: x%s
skill.basicrpgclasses.heal.description: Instantly restores a small amount of health to the selected ally. Without a target it heals the Priest.
skill.basicrpgclasses.blink.description: Moves the Mage forward, leaving a magical trail and briefly protecting them after arrival.
skill.basicrpgclasses.magic_shield.descr: Cleanses the Mage and up to five allies, then gives the Mage a very short window of full invulnerability.
skill.basicrpgclasses.mage_glide.descrip: Passive: after jumping, release and press Space again in mid-air. Gliding preserves entry momentum and allows directional movement in the air.
skill.basicrpgclasses.mage_glide.stats: Descent speed: %s · air control: %s · cost: %s Mana/s
skill.basicrpgclasses.mage_mana_regen.de: Passively accelerates the Mage's Mana regeneration.
skill.basicrpgclasses.frost_nova.descrip: Detonates frost energy at the aimed point, damaging and heavily slowing every creature in the area.
skill.basicrpgclasses.frost_nova.stats: Damage: %s · radius: %s · slow: %s s · effect level: %s
skill.basicrpgclasses.meteor.description: Select a location and hold RMB until the cast bar fills. Releasing RMB, moving, or taking damage interrupts it.
skill.basicrpgclasses.sky_rays.descripti: Select an area and hold RMB. Green rune portals at varied heights beam down onto ground crosses inside the area.
skill.basicrpgclasses.sky_rays.stats: Damage per target: %s · targets: %s · search radius: %s
skill.basicrpgclasses.chain_lightning.de: The Priest's holy chain lightning strikes the aimed enemy and jumps to nearby targets.
skill.basicrpgclasses.chain_lightning.st: Initial damage: %s · targets: %s · jump range: %s · retained damage: %s%%
skill.basicrpgclasses.dash.description: Dashes in the movement or look direction, including sideways, backward and upward. The next landing deals no damage.
skill.basicrpgclasses.windrun.descriptio: Briefly accelerates the Hunter. Direct mob attacks miss, while direct PvP damage is reduced by 20%%.
skill.basicrpgclasses.windrun.stats: Duration: %s s · Speed %s · direct PvP damage reduction: 20%%
skill.basicrpgclasses.camouflage.descrip: Grants invisibility, hides held items and clears mob targets. Dealing or taking damage breaks camouflage.
skill.basicrpgclasses.multishot.descript: Toggle. Every normal bow shot fires a fan of extra arrows while consuming one arrow and paying Mana once.
skill.basicrpgclasses.arrow_rain.descrip: Arms the next shot. The rain starts at its impact point and accurately targets every creature within the radius.
skill.basicrpgclasses.power_shot.descrip: Arms the next arrow, turning it into a fast blue torrent that pierces enemies along its entire path.
skill.basicrpgclasses.frost_arrows.descr: Toggle. While enabled, normal bow arrows consume Mana when fired and slow the target they hit.
skill.basicrpgclasses.frost_arrows.stats: Mana per arrow: %s · slow: %s s · effect level: %s
skill.basicrpgclasses.warrior_vitality.d: Passively increases the Warrior's maximum health and Fury capacity.
skill.basicrpgclasses.mage_vitality.desc: Passively increases maximum health and greatly expands the Mage's Mana capacity.
skill.basicrpgclasses.hunter_vitality.de: Passively increases the Hunter's maximum health and Mana capacity.
skill.basicrpgclasses.hunter_fall_traini: Passively reduces all fall damage taken by the Hunter.
skill.basicrpgclasses.hunter_climbing.de: Passive: hold forward or Space against a wall to climb any surface. Hold Shift to release the wall.
Slightly increases the Hunter's Stamina regeneration.
Passively reduces the time needed to fully draw every Hunter bow.
Passively increases the damage and velocity of every Hunter arrow, including ranged skills.
Passively heals the Warrior from all damage dealt by basic attacks and combat skills.
